newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada deports three men wanted in U.S..
newsitem.headline: Canada deports three men wanted in U.S..

text.p: A man accused of murder in California and two accused rapists were ordered deported to the United States Tuesday in separate immigration hearings, the Canadian Press reported.
Pong Chan Nguyen, 22, who burned his eight fingertips to avoid being traced in connection with a murder in California last May, will likely be returned to American authorities within days.
Two U.S. police officers were in Toronto Tuesday for Nguyen's extradition hearing.
Nguyen was arrested last Friday by Toronto police and immigration officers. He was wanted for alleged fraud offenses in Kentucky and in connection with the murder of a 20-year-old college student.
Immigration Canada spokeswoman Anna Pape said two men arrested last week in the resort community of Wasaga Beach for allegedly raping two 14-year-old girls in Pennsylvania were also ordered deported.
Daniel Tappe, 22, and Kimber Kauwell, 20, will be returned to Bloomsburg, Pa., to face charges of statutory sexual assault and indecent assault on a person under 18 years of age.
